premises.text: Educational content is mostly static/linear because dynamic interactive content is too slow and costly to produce
premises.evidence_span: 98% of this content is both static and linear. Only 2% of it is dynamic. The reason for this is it takes such a lot of time and money to produce

premises.text: Future learner problems and jobs are uncertain, yet courses still take months or years to develop
premises.evidence_span: It's no longer clear what problems our learners need to solve tomorrow, nor is it clear what jobs will be available or what we should train them for. And yet, our educational systems are forced to guess because it'll take them months, if not years, to develop courses

premises.text: Knowledge AI generates interactive bite-sized e-learning packages ~100x faster and plug-and-play for any learning environment
premises.evidence_span: generate interactive bite-sized e-education, e-learning packages, 100 times faster, plug-and-play ready for any learning environment

premises.text: Knowledge LX generates full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real time
premises.evidence_span: With Knowledge LX, we generate full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real-time

premises.text: Go-to-market is B2B AI backend integrations into LMS platforms (Canvas, Google Classroom, Microsoft, Ilias)
premises.evidence_span: We focus on being the behind-the-scenes, AI-ready solutions provider, while our partners provide distribution through their platforms. We've worked carefully with the teams at Canvas, Google Classroom, Microsoft, and Ilias to launch the first few integrations
